svg.aria-label: Full UML class diagram of the parking lot: ParkingLot owns Floor and ParkingTicket and depends on PricingCalculator; Floor owns ParkingSpot; ParkingTicket references ParkingSpot; FlatRatePricing and ProRataPricing implement PricingCalculator; Bike, Car and Truck extend the abstract Vehicle class; ParkingSpot depends on the SpotSize enum.
